name: Real World Geometry Applications
description: Practical geometry problems from architecture, engineering, and daily life

exercises.title: Garden Design
exercises.problem: A rectangular garden is 15 feet by 20 feet. If you want to put a fence around it, how much fencing do you need?

exercises.title: Pizza Area
exercises.problem: A large pizza has a diameter of 16 inches. What is its area? (Use π ≈ 3.14)

exercises.title: Construction - Roof Angle
exercises.problem: A roof rises 8 feet over a horizontal distance of 12 feet. What is the angle of the roof?

exercises.title: Swimming Pool Volume
exercises.problem: A cylindrical pool has a diameter of 24 feet and is 4 feet deep. How many cubic feet of water does it hold?

exercises.title: Satellite Dish Angle
exercises.problem: To receive a signal from a satellite 22,236 miles above the equator, at what angle should a dish be tilted if you're at 40° north latitude?
